title: Address representation of recursive majority
statement: For every depth $d\in\mathbb{N}$ and every sign input $x$ indexed by the integers from $0$ to $3^d-1$, recursive majority of depth $d$ on $x$ equals the address-based recursive majority of depth $d$ on the function that assigns to each ternary formula address the input sign at its corresponding index under the canonical indexing equivalence.
hypotheses_covered: A sign input indexed by $3^d$ coordinates
